card.name: The "ise" in Advise before risks
card.fires_on: The final piece "ise" of the word "Advise" (split as Adv + ise) at the start of a sentence in embryo-fetal toxicity or pregnancy-risk text. It follows a statement of fetal harm.

modes.label: Advise pregnant women
modes.description: "Advise" opens the counseling sentence after fetal harm is described, addressed to pregnant women.

modes.description: "Advise" opens a sentence about risks to patients or females of reproductive potential.
